system.description:
This skill only produces an effect when you are equipped with only one [One-Handed] melee weapons. Your [Attack Power] becomes [Weapon's (Attack Power) x2]. For the first round of a scene, your [Evasion] and [Resistance] is increased by 1. 

(SR2): Your [Evasion] and [Resistance] are increased by 1 for the whole scene.

A fighting style that makes full use of easy-to-handle weapons and attacks the enemy with light movements like a raging fire.
